summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A., a Peruvian cement company, filed a 6-K reporting a mandatory public tender offer (OPA) arising from Holcim Ltd.'s indirect acquisition of a 50.01% stake via Inversiones ASPI S.A. shares. The filing responds to SMV information requests regarding share valuation for the OPA. No specific price, premium, or closing date was stated. The board has not yet issued a recommendation, and no advisor was named. The OPA is required under Peruvian regulations. Watch for the tender offer terms, regulatory review, and minority shareholder response.
